body:
The /annotations/import KoboReader.sqlite recovery path drops real highlights whose device
ContentID is a BARE chapter path with no uuid prefix (e.g. 'OPS/../OPS/chapter-003.xml',
'OEBPS/../OEBPS/chapter001.html') - a shape newer Libra Colour firmware (4.46.23836) writes for
some annotations. normalize_content_id has no branch for it, so ingest_bookmarks counts
skipped_invalid_content_id and loses the row even though the book was already resolved via
VolumeID. MEASURED 2026-08-31 on a real device import: 88/90 highlights in one book and 9/72 in
another were dropped; prefixing '<book_uuid>!!' onto those ContentIDs in a copy made all import
cleanly (the _chapter validator already accepts the contained traversal). Fix shape: in the
importer (allow_kobo_device_content_id call site), when the raw ContentID fails the grammar AND
the book is resolved, retry normalize_content_id(book_uuid + '!!' + raw). The live PATCH path
likely faces the same shape and should be checked with the same fixture.
title: Kobo import drops annotations with bare-chapter-path ContentIDs (newer firmware shape)
